decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (519-1AB Received: 09/10/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the flank elevation facing 38 Thornbury Road shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
Condition : 6 - The side and rear faces of the approved rear roof extension shall be clad in black slates to match those used on the roof slopes of the existing house.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension incorporating hip to gable conversion, Juliet balcony and two front roof windows to the house
